info.name: Atlassian Get User Membership for a Workspace

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs: This GET operation retrieves detailed information about a specific user's membership within a designated Bitbucket workspace. By providing the workspace identifier and member identifier in the URL path parameters, the API returns the membership details for that particular user, including their role, permissions, and associated account information within the context of the specified workspace.
